description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDao class, which provides data access methods for Employee entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting employees, and managing relationships like supervisors and subordinates, as well as querying employee details such as work shifts and emails.

classes.name: EmployeeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Employee entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, relationship queries, and filtering within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Returns an array of employee numbers filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching the search filter.

methods.name: getEmployeeListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds and returns a query builder wrapper for fetching employee data based on search filters.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists an Employee entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches an Employee entity by employee number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns existing employee numbers from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Recursively retrieves subordinate employee IDs under a supervisor.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns total number of employees, optionally excluding terminated ones.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Returns a list of subordinate Employee entities for a supervisor, optionally including the chain.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if an employee is a supervisor of others.

methods.name: getReportingMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the reporting method between a subordinate and supervisor.

methods.name: getEmpNumberList
methods.description: Returns a list of employee numbers, optionally excluding terminated employees.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees by their employee numbers.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Recursively retrieves supervisor employee IDs for a subordinate.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Fetches the work shift details for an employee.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeeListForWorkShift
methods.description: Returns employees available for assigning to a work shift.

methods.name: getEmailList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employee email addresses.

methods.name: isEmailAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an email address is available (not used by other employees).

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Verifies if an employee ID is unique within the system.
